card vi-edges  [proto]
Four edge types. No “relates to”.
why: “Relates to” cannot be acted on. IBIS survived 50 years on three edge types.

refines — the level edge. Children get reviewed.
depends_on — propagates staleness through the reverse closure.
supported_by — evidence. Flags for review, never auto-invalidates.
alternative_to — a rejected option, kept, restored when the decision reopens.

The grammar must be small enough to maintain during live conversation. That is the constraint, not expressiveness.

  -> refines         visual  The visual artifact is the primary medium
  -> depends_on      vi-overwrite  The map is overwritten, not appended
  -> supported_by    ibis  Dialogue Mapping and IBIS — Kunz & Rittel, Conklin
  -> supported_by    vi-edges:ex0  
  -> supported_by    vi-edges:ex1  
  <- depends_on      vi-srcnode  Evidence is a node, not inline text
  <- depends_on      vi-prop  Propagation cannot be done by asking a model
  <- depends_on      vi-detail  Every card carries its own proof
  <- depends_on      vi-graph3d  A 3D force-directed graph is a second view, toggled beside the tree

32:export type EdgeType =
33-  | 'refines' // card -> card. The level tree.
34-  | 'depends_on' // card -> card. Propagates staleness.
35-  | 'supported_by' // card -> source | excerpt. Flags for review only.
36-  | 'alternative_to' // option -> card. Kept forever.
